subject: Recap & redlines: Redwood + Finovexa discovery
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@finovexa.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: Redwood + Finovexa discovery

Elena —

Thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for Finovexa's customer-facing fraud-detection workflow (P0 integration).
- Pilot scope: 3 model endpoints (generation + embeddings), 2-week evaluation window, synthetic test data to start.
- Success metrics: 95% availability during peak, <250ms p95 token latency for short prompts, clear cost-per-token estimates.

Action items we agreed:
1) Redwood: share SOW and our standard MSA (attached).
2) Finovexa: loop in procurement and corporate counsel to review terms & confirm redline timeline.
3) Both: schedule a short legal Q/A if counsel wants to walk through key clauses.

Timing: if counsel can share redlines by EOW Sep 12, we should be able to respond and keep a pilot start target in late Sep. If priorities shifted, please let me know.

Attachment: Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if helpful.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Markus / Laura —

Attached are the redlines from counsel (rolled up). High-level callouts:
- Data residency: request to keep all customer PII and logs within EU/US regions depending on account; wants explicit retention caps.
- Logging & audit trail: counsel requests guaranteed access to audit logs for up to 1 year.
- Indemnity & liability: narrower indemnity from Redwood for third-party claims; cap negotiation requested.
- Security controls: confirmation of SOC2 report availability and details on KMS/HSM integrations.

We don’t expect to block the pilot, but procurement asked us to get Redwood’s response to these redlines before issuing PO.

Attachment: Finovexa-MSA-redlines-20270912.pdf (PDF)

Elena —

Following up on counsel’s redlines from Sep 12. We prepared a short response and proposed edits (attached) and wanted to check scheduling/prioritization on your side. If procurement wants to accelerate this, we can:

- Option A: 20-min call with counsel + Laura/Monica to walk through the three outstanding items (data residency, logs, indemnity).
- Option B: We accept the spirit of the redlines and provide a clean MSA with Redwood’s suggested language for review; procurement to confirm PO afterward.
- Option C: Keep as-is for the pilot with a tailored addendum (faster start, finalize full terms within 30 days).

I’ve attached our response document for your counsel to review: Redwood-response-redline-20270918.docx.

Quick asks: could you let me know which option you prefer and the expected timeline from procurement/counsel? If helpful I can set up the call for early next week — Laura and Monica are copied to assist.
